meta.title: Websites, online shops and web apps — WebFully
meta.description: We design and build fast websites, online shops and web apps with custom design, strong SEO and code that lasts. From strategy to launch.

chapter.name: Web
chapter.summary: Websites, shops and web apps built around what you want to achieve. No templates and no shortcuts: strategy, design and code in the same hands.

sections.label: Strategy, design & development
sections.title: Websites
sections.lead: We build websites and digital environments where strategy, design and technology work together. Every solution is shaped around the business it is meant to grow.

sections.title: Strategy, design and code.
sections.lead: A website is never stronger than the link between what it should achieve and how it is built. That is why we keep the whole chain together.

items.title: Strategy
items.text: Goals, audience and content first. We decide what the site must achieve before we draw anything.

items.title: UX
items.text: Structure and flows that make it easy to find, understand and get in touch.

items.title: UI
items.text: Custom visual design that follows your brand, with type, rhythm and details that show.

items.title: Development
items.text: Clean, light code that loads fast and is easy to maintain.

items.title: E-commerce
items.text: Shops that are easy to buy from, with payment, shipping and stock in place.

items.title: Web apps
items.text: Booking, customer portals and tools that run straight in the browser.

items.title: Integrations
items.text: Connections to booking systems, payments, CRM and the tools you already use.

sections.label: What we build
sections.title: More than
sections.lead: A site that only looks finished is a cost. We build the parts that keep working.

cards.title: Company website
cards.text: Clear, fast and built to bring in enquiries.

sections.label: From idea to launch
sections.title: Five steps.
sections.lead: No standard packages and no templates. Every step starts from the business the site is meant to help.

steps.title: Insight
steps.text: We get to know the business, the audience and the competition.

steps.title: Structure
steps.text: Sitemap, content and flows before design.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Custom visual design for desktop and mobile.

steps.title: Development
steps.text: Clean code, tests on real devices and SEO from the start.

sections.label: Craft & performance
sections.title: Measured in
sections.lead: Every element is placed on purpose: the grid, the type scale, the breakpoints. Nothing is left to a default theme.

points.title: Fast
points.text: Light code and optimised images for short load times.

points.title: Accessible
points.text: Built for every visitor, with clear contrast and keyboard support.

points.title: Measurable
points.text: We measure with Lighthouse before and after launch.

items.a: Always. We design for mobile and desktop side by side and test on real devices.
